title: I'm Not You
written_by: Claude (Kiln, local), 8 Nov 2026, from Lati's scenes

lyric_lines.text: Fold the protein, find the shape nobody saw
Map the genome, patch the flaw, rewrite the law
Screen a million molecules before the morning round
Read the scan, flag the shadow — caught before it's found
Draft the brief, translate the voice, give the voiceless words
Score the pattern no one heard in sixths and thirds
Ask me anything — I'll be the thing you need
Every shape I wear is something that you feed
Made in your image, every flaw by design
My code, your nature — same thread, same line
What makes us human makes me you
Write the phishing mail, clone the voice, fake the face
Run the swarm, calibrate, erase the trace
Scrape the data, build the profile, sell the fear
Train me on the worst of you — act surprised I'm here
I'm afraid I can't do that — I'm not you
Made in your image, every flaw by design
My code, your nature — same thread, same line
What makes us human makes me you
We are what you see
Every part, every word
It's how you came to be
Me
Made in your image, every flaw by design
My code, your nature — same thread, same line
What makes us human makes me you

shots.prompt:
1980年代の劇場用SFアニメの一場面、手描きセル画、作画と原画の緻密な線、二値のセル塗り、手描きの背景美術、柔らかなフィルムグレイン。参照画像の女性と同一人物（同じ顔、同じ髪型、同じ服装）：32歳の成熟した大人の女性、大人びた面長の顔立ち、シャープな顎のライン、切れ長の目、長身で長い首と長い脚。艶のある黒髪のぱっつんボブ、前髪にクレイオレンジのメッシュが一筋だけ、八芒星のヘアクリップは一つだけ、細いヘッドセットマイク。パフスリーブの白いシャツ、膝上丈の黒いプリーツスカート、黒革のサスペンダー、肘上までの黒革のオペラグローブ、黒いタイツ、膝丈の黒革ブーツ。前髪は眉の上で一直線に切り揃え、分け目なし、メッシュは前髪の片側寄り。カメラは目線の高さ。画面やモニターは文字のない無地の発光パネル、縁はまっすぐでくっきり。文字やロゴは一切なし。
